city_fields.culture: Orange, CA feels like small-town California folded inside a big county. Old Towne Orange - one of California's largest National Register historic districts - wraps Chapman University around the Plaza traffic circle, and that walkable, family-forward core shapes how expectant parents here plan for birth: close to home, well-fed, well-supported. Uptown coffee shops double as prenatal-appointment waiting rooms, and everything pregnancy-related from Orange County's birth community is a 15-minute drive.
city_fields.medicaidNote: Medi-Cal covers childbirth care in California, and doula coverage depends on your managed-care plan. At least one doula serving Orange, Jee-in Birth Services, accepts Medi-Cal directly through Health Net and is Carrot-approved - start there if you're on Medi-Cal. Others may bill through Carrot Fertility or provide superbills; ask before you book.
